prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 34 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1144; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the soft tissue injuries observed. Imaging and physical examination findings confirm cervical and lumbar strain. No prior injury to these regions is known. The patient has attended 34 visits to date. Treatment frequency and the range of services have grown over several months, with new modalities added at successive stages, well beyond what is typically required for this type of strain. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing management includes active therapy and home exercise instruction, with reassessment planned to determine whether further visits remain medically necessary.
